title: Add metrics sidecar source backfill
summary: Adds backend-owned Metrics sidecar source roots and recursive sidecar backfill cache support, plus Metrics page controls for adding multiple roots and running backfill.
reason: Operators may have completed sidecars spread across multiple drives. Metrics needs a safe way to add those roots and recursively backfill aggregate data without touching media files or rewriting sidecars.
behavior_before: Metrics aggregated completed manifest, pending publish, worker, and final-library evidence only. There was no Metrics-managed way to add sidecar roots from multiple drives or recursively backfill sidecar data into Metrics.
behavior_after: Metrics can persist multiple source roots under State\Metrics, recursively scan enabled roots for *.pipeline.json sidecars, cache read-only sidecar payloads under State\Metrics, merge cached rows with completed-manifest rows using logical dedupe, and render source/backfill state in the Metrics Overview tab.
